concept.title: Community cafes and shared meals
concept.shortdesc: Eating and drinking together at cafes, lunch and breakfast clubs, coffee mornings and drop-ins, plus learning to cook healthy meals.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Learning to cook and prepare healthy meals, in classes, courses and sessions, including help with meal preparation.
: Visiting a community or on-site cafe to eat or drink, including pay-as-you-feel and low-cost cafes.
: Attending a breakfast club or community breakfast, including school breakfast clubs and informal breakfast get-togethers.
: Attending a regular lunch, dinner or food club where people share a meal or collect low-cost food.
: Eating a lunch or hot meal at a venue, from a light lunch to a three-course meal, often as part of a day out or social occasion.
: Attending a coffee morning or coffee meet-up to socialise over tea, coffee and cake.
: Receiving free or low-cost hot drinks, snacks, cake and light meals at a warm or welcoming venue.
: Dropping in for a cup of tea or coffee, cake and informal conversation with others.
